en:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!

The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!
{PLAYER} received TM34\nfrom LT. SURGE.
TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!
Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!
Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!
When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.
Stop!\nYou're very good!
It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.
I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.
Fried!
Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.
This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!
Wow!\nSurprised me!

LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.
Whew!\nThat match was electric!
VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
Nope!\nThere's only trash here.
Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!
The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!
Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!
